reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I absolutely love this ampoule! It has a lightweight yet nourishing texture and leaves my skin feeling calm, hydrated, and soft. It absorbs nicely without feeling greasy, and my skin looks healthier and more balanced after using it. Perfect for sensitive and irritated skin. I will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我真係超鍾意呢支安瓶精華！質地輕盈但係滋養，令我嘅皮膚感覺平靜、水潤、柔軟。吸收好好，唔會覺得油膩，用完之後皮膚睇落更健康、更平衡。非常啱敏感同不適嘅皮膚。我一定會回購！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text:
I use it at night time and my skin has never been better! Very rich and hydrating.
My skin is quite sensitive due to the rosacea so I am always very scared of trying new products since some, even when highly recommended, do not work well with me, but this one has been marvellous!
reviews.zh:
我晚上用，我嘅皮膚從來冇咁好過！質地好豐富，保濕力好強。
因為玫瑰痤瘡，我嘅皮膚幾敏感，所以我一直都好驚試新產品，因為有啲產品就算被大力推薦，都未必啱我，不過呢款就表現出色。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: The SKIN1004 Probio-Cica Serum is incredibly soothing and hydrating. It calms my sensitive skin instantly and helps strengthen the skin barrier over time. The texture is light, absorbs quickly, and layers well with other products. My skin looks healthier, less red, and more balanced since I started using it. A must-have for sensitive or compromised skin!
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 Probio-Cica Serum 非常舒緩同保濕。佢即刻令我嘅敏感皮膚平靜落嚟，長期用仲有助加強皮膚屏障。質地輕盈，吸收快，同其他產品疊用都好好。由我開始用，我嘅皮膚睇落更健康、冇咁紅、更平衡。對於敏感或者受損皮膚嚟講，係必備產品！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: first impressions- a little goes a long way, no scent, a bit slimy texture, feels very hydrating. Glass bottle feels luxurious. 1 week: feels a bit like the APIB glutathione serum- nicely hydrating. Have noticed my skin is a bit dry after a few hours so not as hydrating as i like. 1 month- good, hydrating, pleasant to use but other products are better.
reviews.zh: 第一印象——少少就好夠用，冇香味，質地有少少滑溜，感覺好保濕。玻璃樽好有質感。1 個星期：感覺有啲似 APIB glutathione 精華——保濕做得唔錯。不過我留意到幾個鐘之後皮膚有啲乾，所以冇我想要嘅咁保濕。1 個月：好，保濕，用起嚟舒服，不過有其他產品更好。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule has been a game-changer for my skin, soothing irritation and boosting hydration with just a few drops. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and has made my skin feel calmer and more balanced over time.
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 對我嘅皮膚嚟講係一個改變遊戲規則嘅產品，只係滴幾滴，就舒緩刺激同提升保濕。佢質地輕盈、吸收快，長期用令我嘅皮膚感覺更加平靜、更加平衡。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: really nice, it helped with repairing my skin barrier after a rlly bad breakout
reviews.zh: 好好，喺我嚴重爆痘之後幫咗我修護皮膚屏障。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: The ampoule is thick and sticky at first but rubs in so nicely. Very light and water based feeling. Absorbs very quick and skin feels instantly glowing and moisturized. Have only used twice but I love the way this feels and will probably order this again
reviews.zh: 安瓶一開始質地稠、有啲黏，但係推開好順滑。感覺好輕盈，似水性嘅質感。吸收好快，皮膚即刻有光澤又滋潤。我只係用咗兩次，但係好鍾意呢種感覺，相信會再買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
